title: Schrödinger Glide Docking
description: High-throughput virtual screening using Schrödinger Glide with LigPrep ligand preparation and GlideScore ranking.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

receptor.description: Receptor PDB, MAE, or MAEGZ file.

ligands.description: Ligand SDF, SMI, or MAEGZ file.

docking_precision.description: Glide docking precision. HTVS = ultra-fast screening (millions of compounds); SP = standard precision (thousands); XP = extra precision (hundreds, most accurate).
docking_precision.help_text: Use HTVS for initial filtering, SP for lead finding, XP for lead optimisation.

grid_center.description: Docking grid center as '[x,y,z]' string. Auto-detected from ref_ligand if not specified.

ref_ligand.description: Reference ligand SDF/MAE for automatic grid box centering.

grid_inner_box.description: Inner sampling box size in Å. Should accommodate the binding site.

grid_outer_box.description: Outer bounding box size in Å.

poses_per_ligand.description: Number of docked poses to retain per ligand.

top_n.description: Number of top-ranked poses in the final SDF output.

ligprep_ph.description: Target pH for LigPrep ionisation state generation. 7.4 = physiological.

ligprep_ph_tolerance.description: pH tolerance (±) around target pH for ionisation states.

max_stereoisomers.description: Maximum stereoisomers to generate per ligand.

use_epik.description: Apply Epik metal-binding state penalties during scoring.

use_samplering.description: Enable ring conformation sampling during docking.

n_cpus.description: CPU cores for parallel ligand preparation and docking.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
